================
Function call - no arguments
================

f[]

---

(source_file
  (call
    head: (symbol)))

================

================

  (call
    head: (symbol)
    arguments: (symbol)))

================

================

---

    head: (symbol)
    arguments: (infix
      (symbol)
      (symbol))))
